snippet.title: Perfect Flow - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
A fast-paced platformer where you control the timing of obstacles. Help Hungry Guy navigate a world filled with various hazards to reach and devour the best kebab in the world.

See more at https://orideveloper.itch.io/perfect-flow
